tei:div.tei:p: "$ (237)༄༅// phyag chen ga'u ma'am rang babs rnam gsum zhes bya ba'i khrid yig bzhugs so//

(238)༄༅// na mo gu ru we// phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'am rang babs rnam gsum zhes bya ba/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i gdams ngag 'di la/ khrid kyi sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ mi rtag pa/ sdug bsngal sogs spyi dang mthun/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ a yi stong ra rnams ni gu chos drug dang 'dra/ thun gyi sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gzhan sgyu lus dang 'dra ba las maṇ+ḍal mang du 'bul/ bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs bar mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa khyad par ro// khrid dngos la/ sngon 'gro rang babs rnam gsum/ dngos gzhi skyon bzhi rang grol/ rjes sku gsum rang shar gyi khrid do// dang po la zhi gnas gyi khrid dang*/ lhag mthong gi khrid gnyis/ dang po la dmigs pa'i gzhi dang*/ bogs 'don no// dang po ni/ sngar sgo gsum gyi bya ba thams cad (239)don med la dor song 'dug pas/ da phyin chad sgom la brtan pa cung zad cig ma skyes bar mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan lta ci smos/ spros bcas dge ba yang rtsol ba glod/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun/ ngag rlung ro lan gsum bsal nas smra brjod lta ci smos rlung 'dzin 'dren tsam yang spong ba'i rang babs/ sems ma bcos pa lhod de glod/ dmigs skor gcig /rnam rtog sna tshogs 'phro na lam gyis skyes pa la ngo shes/ 'phro rbad kyis bcad la bzhag /dmigs skor gnyis/ 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams su 'gro na/ nam dran dus phyin chad 'di 'dra gtan nas ma byung ba byed snyam zhe dam bya/ rnam rtog byung tsa na dran cing ngo shes pa byed snyam pa byas pas sel te/ dmigs skor gsum/ de dus shes pa mi gsal bar song*/ brjed ngas kyang cher 'gro na bying ba'i skyon yin/ rig pa bsgrim/ mig dpangs gtod/ mthongs dkar ba dang yang thog la sogs par bsgom/

bying ba 'phro bcad de langs ba sogs byed/ (240)yang tshig pa za zhing sbun langs na rgod pa yin pas lhod kyis glod/ lta stangs smad/ 'dod yon la dga' bas sems g.yengs na/ mi rtag sdug bsngal la yid 'byung bar bya ste dmigs skor bzhi pa'o// gnyis pa la lta stangs nges med la bslab pa/ chos spyod sna tshogs la bslab pa/ spyod lam sna tshogs dang bsre ba'o// dang po ni/ mig gi lta stangs mtho ba thag nye ba thog mthil lta bu dang*/ ring ba ri rtse'am nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu la mnyam par bzhag ste dmigs skor lnga/ dma' ba nye brtsig 'khris sam ring ba ri rtsib lta bu la mnyam par bzhag ste drug pa'o// thad ka nye ba gyang ldan nam ring ba ri ldan lta bu la mnyam par bzhag ste bdun pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ mdo 'don/ sngags zlos/ gtam sna tshogs dang bsre zhes ba'i don mdo la sogs pa kha ton byang ba rnams dang thog mar bsre/ rim gyis kha ton thams cad dang bsre gang thub bya ste brgyad pa'o// sngags thung ba rnams dang thog mar bsre/ de nas bzlas ba thams cad dang bsre ste dgu pa'o// dang por chu sgra sogs 'byung ba'i sgra dang bsre/ de nas mi mang po'i ca co dang sgo 'then sogs dang bsre/ de nas mi gzhan gyis gtam smra ba la bsres te de dag gi sgra lhang lhang ba der had de bzhag ste dmigs skor bcu pa'o// gsum pa spyod lam sna tshogs la bslab ste/ zas za na yang rang babs kyi ngang nas za/ lam du 'gro na yang de bzhin du sbyang*/ gtam smra na yang rang babs gyis ngang nas ma bral bar bya ste/ dang por sgrim mi dgos bar do gal chung ba rnams la sbyangs pas mthar thams cad la 'byongs pa yin no// de bzhin du bde sdug /dga' mi dga'/ yang bag tsha ngo tsha skyug bro sogs mtho dman (241)gyi rnam rtog skye ba'i yul thams cad la rang babs su bsres kyin sbyang*// thams cad kyang sngar ltar dge sbyor gyi ngang du tshud 'ong ste dmigs skor bcu gcig pa'o// de ltar na zhi gnas la dmigs skor bcu gcig go

/gnyis pa lhag mthong gi khrid sems tshol ni/ bla ma'i zhal rgyun las rgyas par 'byung ba'i dbang du byas na/ dang po sngar bzhin rang babs gsum gnad du babs nas lhod kyi klod pa'i ngang nas 'tshol ba ni thams cad kyi sngon 'gro yin no// dngos gzhi dmigs thun bdun te/ sems kyi ngo bo la 'tshol ba/ skye 'gag la 'tshol ba/ yul snang la 'tshol ba/ rnam rtog la 'tshol ba/ yul snang yod med kyi khyad par la 'tshol ba/ rnam rtog yod med kyi khyad par la 'tshol ba/ rang bzhin dbyings su thag bcad pa'o// dang po ni/ sems kyi ngo bo la che re lta zhing zhib tu gzhig pa 'jug pa ste/ der rtsol ba rang zhig la song nas 'di yin brjod du med pa'i nyams skyes pa na rang babs su 'jog ste dmigs skor gcig go /gnyis pa ni/ sems rtog med de kho na la bltas nas skye 'gag gtan mi byed pa'i rtag pa brtan pa zhig 'dug gam/ skye 'gag byed pa'i ci med cang med zhig 'dug /skye 'gag byed na ji ltar skye yin 'dug /gnas na ji ltar gnas/ kha dog dbyibs sogs ji lta bu/ phyi nang gang na 'dug /'gag na ji ltar 'gag zhes sogs zhib tu brtags pa na/ ngos bzung med pa la zhi ste/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o// gsum pa ni/ mig gis gzugs mthong na/ gzugs su lam mer mthong ba de ngo bo ji ltar 'dug blta// de dang sems rig rig tur tur 'di gcig gam/ tha dad khyad ci (242)'dug zhib tu dpyad/ de bzhin rna bas sgra thos pa sogs la'ang sbyar te/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ yang rnam rtog lam gyis 'char ba 'di dang sems kyi rang bzhin la khyad par cig 'dug /de gnyis gcig mi gcig brtag /rnam rtog skyes pa'i tshe ji ltar skye/ skyes nas ma 'gags pa'i skabs yod lugs ga 'dra zhig 'dug /'gag tsa na 'gag lugs ci 'dra zhig 'dug zhib tu brtags te/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o// lnga pa ni/ mig gis gzugs mthong ba'i dus kyi sems dang ma mthong ba'i dus kyi sems la khyad ci 'dra zhig 'dug

/yod na yod lugs dang med na med lugs ji ltar yin brtags te/ dmigs skor lnga pa'o// drug pa ni/ rnam rtog skyes pa'i dus kyi sems dang ma skyes pa'i dus kyi sems la bzang ngan gsal mi gsal stong mi stong khyad yod med legs par brtags/ 'tshol thabs de bzhi la'ang mthar dmigs gtad zhig pa zhig 'byung bas de kho na'i ngang bskyongs dmigs skor dgu pa'o// bdun pa ni/ snang ba 'di thams cad rang gi sems su thag bcad/ sems la legs par brtags pa na ngos bzung ci yang med pa dang de kha'i ngang la bzhag /da rung mang du btsal bas/ ngos bzung med bzhin du ci med cang med kyang ma yin par stong bzhin du sna tshogs su 'char ba'i rig stong rjen ne ba/ wa le khyug ge ba/ hrig ger myong ba/ brjod mi shes pa de la cham gyis bzhag ste dmigs skor bdun pa'o// de ltar lhag mthong la bdun no// sngon 'gro rang babs rnam gsum la dmigs skor bco brgyad do// khyung po'i bla ma ni gu mas sngon 'gro la gtso bor mdzad/ mai tri pas dngos gzhi la gtso bor mdzad/ su kha sid+dhi yi rjes la gtso bor mdzad (243)gsungs te ngon 'gro'i skabs 'dir rtogs pa skye dgos so// dngos gzhi la thog mar byin rlabs kyi sgo nas brku thabs su ngo sprod pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung mthing kha zhig bzhengs/ der mañdzi'i steng du gtor ma che ba la mda' dar btsugs shing rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa zhig bzhag /mdun du 'bul gtor dang mchod pa dang tshogs rdzas rnams bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang 'dra/ slob dpon rang gis bde mchog lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs bsgoms la/ mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal dang gtor ma su m+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ gtor chog ltar mgon por bskyed pa nas bzlas pa'i bar bya/ de nas slob ma rnams la khrus dang me tog bkye bsdu sogs bya/ maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul la/ slob ma rnams la bde mchog lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs phog la cung zad sems 'dzin du 'jug

/mdun bskyed mgon por skad cig gis bsgom du bcug cing*/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma sku mdog smug nag ḍā ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭāṃ ga bsnams pa gar stabs dang rus pa'i rgyan can/ lang tsho dar la babs pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro sde lnga mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs par bsam/ de rnams la dngos su bshams pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di nyid stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su mos/ de gser gyis bkang zhing 'bul bar bsam/ dpon slob rnams kyis lhan cig tu tshogs dang gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ byin rlabs kyi chog ni yi dam gang byed kyi nang mchod ltar byin(244)gyis brlab/ oṃ hriḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pas dang por bla ma dang yi dam la phul/ de nas gtor chog ltar mgon po 'khor bcas la phul/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs kyis mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul/ snyims pa me tog dang bcas pas gsol 'debs 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha tshogs ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag la phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa ngo 'phrod par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyis bdag phyag rgya chen po zhu ba dang nyams su len pa la phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa gang yang mi 'byung bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

rtsa ba'i bla ma la mos gus dung pa byed du bcug /lus gnad bcas rlung rang babs su rgyu ru gzhug /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad 'od du zhu nas slob ma rang nyid la thim par mos la dar cig lhod kyis glod nas/ sems kyi rang ngo la lhan ner ltos shig byas la yug cig mnyam par 'jog tu bcug /da lta sems ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba/ rjen ne ye re ba 'di ka rang sems skye med chos sku'am/ tha mal shes pa'am rang babs zhes bya ba yin pas/ da phyin chad 'di ka mnyam rjes thams cad du bzo bcos med par skyongs shig byas/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul (245)ba dang smon lam btab pa sogs spyi dang mthun// gnyis pa ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar ltar la/ gnas 'gyu thams cad du dran pas zin pa zhig bya'o// zhes yang yang 'dun pa byas nas/ dmigs pa'i dngos gzhi la sems gnas pa'i tshe/ kha nang log tu rang ngo shes pa tsam byas nas/ bzo bcos med pa'i tshul du bzhag /yul snang gi 'char sgo'am/ rnam rtog gi 'char sgo ci byung yang ched gtad dgag sgrub blang dor mi bya bar gang shar de rang ngo shes tsam gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas rnam rtog kho rang ma 'gags bzhin du gsal sing nge ba de'i ngang bskyang*/ ngo mi shes su gcig kyang ma shor bar bya/ ngo shes dang ma bral phyin chad 'gyu na'ang 'gyu ru bcug /rang log tu 'gro na'ang 'gro ru bcug dran pa la ched gtad du 'bad/ 'di la bsgom du rdul tsam med/ yengs su skad cig kyang med ces bya/ de nyid la skyon bzhi rang grol bar ngo sprad de/ nye drags pas ngo ma shes/ zab drags pas ngos ma zin/ sla drags pas yid ma ches/ bzang drags pas blor ma shong zhes pa'i skyon bzhi las grol ba ste/ dang po ni rang ngo ma shes pa/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar 'chi ba dang shugs chad kyi nyams la sogs pa'i dus su tha mal shes pa rang ngo gsal bar ston pa mang du byung mod kyang*/ bla ma'i gdams ngag gis ngo ma sprad pa de srid thabs gang gis kyang ma shes pa'o// gsum pa ni/

mkhas rmongs thams cad bya ra med la blos ma khel ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas yin pa blor ma shong pa'o// de la gnas 'gyu thams cad rang ngo shes tsam na rang bzhin stong gsal du 'dug /des na gang shar la bzo bcos byed don med/ rang bzhin gsal (246)stong 'di las logs su 'khor 'das gang yang med par shes tshe skyon de bzhi rang grol ba yin// gsum pa rjes sku gsum rang shar la/ sku gsum rang shar ngo sprad pa dngos dang*/ de'i bogs 'don no// dang po ni/ sngar gyi tha mar shes pa ma bcos so ma de nyid sngon gdod ma nas gsal stong zung 'jug tu rang shar bar rang ngo shes pa nas stong pa chos kyi sku/ gsal ba sprul sku/ zung 'jug longs skur thag bcad nges shes bskyed nas rang babs de ka'i ngang du bskyang bar bya'o// de ltar nyams su myong ba'i tshe/ sems skad cig ma gcig kyang sku gsum du ngo 'phrod/ rnam rtog skad cig ma gcig kyang sku gsum gyi rang bzhin no// de ltar nyams myong du shar bar byas nas rtag tu skyong dgos pa yin no// gnyis pa la/ bogs 'don dang gegs sel gnyis las/ dang po la mos gus tshad med la brten nas bogs 'don pa/ snying rje tshad med la brten nas bogs 'don pa/ thabs khyad par can la brten nas bogs 'don pa'o// dang po ni spyir rtogs pa skyes na mos gus shugs 'byung la 'byung*/ ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje rang shugs kyis skye yang*/ de la slar yang mos gus dang snying rje bsgom pas me 'bar ba la shing gcer ba bzhin du cher 'phel te lam gyi bogs 'don bla na med par 'gyur ba yin no// de ltar yang yang lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom bzhin du mos gus dang snying rje drag tu bsgoms pas mthar thug rtogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur ro// de yang mos gus ni spyir rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas dngos yin pa dang*/ thugs chos kyi sku mdzad spyod phrin las thams cad gzhan don gzugs sku rnam gnyis sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong (247)thams cad 'dus pa 'ong ba yin par thag gcod/

bdag gnas lugs la dkri bar mdzad pas bka' drin che/ bka' drin la nam yang 'khor ba med snyam pa mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs/ bla ma'i mos gus kyis yid bsgyur bas rang bzhin spros bral gyi ye shes lhag ger shar ba na/ de kha'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad drin chen gyi pha ma yin par rang sems ngo ma shes pas nyon mongs dang las bsags te 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di cis kyang snying re rje zhes yid la bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod/ mthar snying rje bya yul snying rje byed mkhan thams cad ngos bzung dang bral ba'i ngang der cham mer bzhag /gsum pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ tha mal shes pa rlung dang bsre// rnam rtog ma rig 'gag par 'gyur/ zhes pa'i don ni/ sems ma bcos par phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog cing*/ rlung bum pa can drag tu bzung bas rlung sems 'jug pa gcig pa'i phyir/ rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur/ gnyis pa ni// 'od gsal lha sku rlung dang bsre// nyams myong yar ngo bzhin du 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes chu nang gi zla gzugs ltar snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ lha skur snang ba ma 'gag pa de ka ma bcos/ so ma/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen pos zin par byas la rlung drag tu gcun pas phyag chen la lha skus bogs thon te nyams myong gong 'phel du 'gyur ro// gsum pa ni// zung 'jug shes pa rlung dang bsre// 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ rang lha sku gsal stong du bsgom/ gzhan lus shes rab ma'am/ rang lus thabs ldan ltar na gtum mo (248)dang 'od gsal gyi nyams myong gis lha sku la rgyas btab ste/ de nyid phyag chen gyis zin par byas la gzhur te bsgom/ ngag rlung bum pa can drag tu bzung*/ lha skur gsal ba sprul sku/ phyag chen mi rtog pa chos sku/

bde ba longs sku/ de gsum ka'i grogs rlung gis byas te/ lam dus kyi sku gsum nyams su blangs pas gzhi dus kyi sems kyi rang bzhin 'bras bu'i tshul du mngon du 'gyur ro// ji srid du rtsa bral mngon du ma gyur pa de srid 'bad rtsol chen pos 'du 'dzi spangs nas dben par bsgom pa gal che'o// gnyis pa gegs sel ni/ rtsa log rlung log sogs gegs sel te chos drug sogs thabs lam gyi yan lag yin pas thun mong bar song ste 'dir mi 'chad/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i gegs bsal ba ni/ nyams kyi rtsis ma bcings pa dang*/ snang stong phyogs rer ma shor ba la 'bad pa ste/ de yang bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum la zhen na gol bas/ lus sems dga' bde ci skyes dang*/ rig pa la dngas cha dang gsal cha ci byung dang*/ stong sang sang po'i mi rtog pa'i nyams ci shar la dga' zhen med bar bskyur/ nyams mthug drags pas bshig mi thub pa 'dra ba byung na mi sgom par snang ba'i steng du gang dgar bskyur la 'jog /bde gsal stong par zhig pa na gnas lugs rjen gyis 'char/ sems kyi snang cha dang gsal cha dang 'char sgo la bden zhen skye/ chags sdang 'dzin zhen rags su song ba'i nyams byed na/ sgyu ma lta bur mos shing btsal bas mi rnyed pa la 'jog /des de stong par 'chad/ rang sems kyi ngo bo la'ang khyad mi 'dug pas las 'bras spang blang mi dgos so snyam pa'i log lta skyes na/ las 'bras bden par med kyang kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med/ me mi bden kyang shing tshig /chu mi bden kyang gsher ba mi 'gag pa ltar (249)las 'bras la yid ches bskyed dgos so// de ltar nyams su blang*// de la sems gsal stong 'dzin med du gnas na zhi gnas yin te/ bying rgod gnyis sel ba zhig dgos/ snang ba thams cad sems/ gnas 'gyu thams cad ngos bzung med par myong thog tu phebs na lhag mthong skyes pa yin no// gang shar la rang ngo shes pas bzo bcos med par skyong thub na phyag chen dngos gzhi'i rtogs pa skyes pa yin no// sems la ci bsam/

snang ba la ci shar thams cad dran pa dang rtsol ba brten mi dgos pa thams cad rang ngo shes pa'i gsal stong rgya 'byams su song ba'i tshe/ rtsa bral zhes bya ba rjes kyi nyams myong mthar phyin pa yin no// zhes pa 'di'ang tā ra nā thas shar kong po'i yul gyi bshes gnyen mkhyen rab ces bya ba'i don du nye bar gdams pa'o// dge'o// (250)
